title: Add configurable footer element
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

As discussed in this #7583 pull request, I propose to add a configurable footer element.
Since we used to patch the "hard-coded" Streamlit footer to add some imprint information, the footer is gone now and there is no real way to deal with such requirements.

### Why?

Footer has been removed. Furthermore, it was not designed for easy configuration. Inline css patching was required to change the content which does not follow Streamlit's easy-to-use interfaces.

### How?

Set the "Made with Streamlit" footer by default. Make the footer configurable, e.g.
```
st.footer(text="Imprint: My Company", activate=True)
```
or via a global configuration:
```
st.set_page_config(footer="Imprint: My Company")
```

### Additional Context

_No response_
